characters.name: Mole
characters.imagePrompt: A gentle, anthropomorphic mole with velvety black fur that is lightly smudged with white streaks of dried plaster and dust. He has a small, round, wet nose, sensitive whiskers, and expressive, blinking eyes. He is wearing a tiny, makeshift apron over his stout frame, appearing weary but industrious. The character is set within a cozy, dimly lit burrow filled with soft, warm earth tones, capturing his exhaustion after a long morning of spring cleaning. The overall aesthetic follows a whimsical, neo-impressionist watercolor style, featuring vibrant, sun-drenched palette accents, soft-focus textures, and loose, gestural brushstrokes that emphasize his charming, tired posture.
